content:
Hay so laawol ooto-jaaɓi ɗiin tan ngonnono leɗɗe ɗe ɓaawi ɗe ngoni e jooɗorgol gooto, ɗe ndaareno ɗiin puccu ɗi ɗe ndaɗata ngaɗa sooynde ɓurnde ɓuri, e ɗi ndaɗata cuuɗi ɓurɗi ɓeydaade ɓuri laawol ndiyam ɗum ɓuri ɗuuɗugo e nder ñalnde.

Sorry — here is a cleaner version:

Hay so laawolji ooto-jaaɓi ɗin ngonnono tan leɗɗe ɗe ngoni nder ɗemngal gootal, ɗe kaɗini puccu ɗin ɗi ndaɗata ɗe ngaɗa yaawugol ɓuri, ɗi ndaɗata e hoore ɓuri ɓeydaade, ɓuri laawolji tampuɗi seɗɗa ɗi ñalnde oo.
